q: 22 सितंबर 2026 को एकता नगर (गुजरात) में आयोजित 72वें राष्ट्रीय फिल्म पुरस्कार समारोह में प्रतिष्ठित दादासाहेब फाल्के पुरस्कार (2024 हेतु) किसे प्रदान किया गया?
e: Veteran Kannada actor Anant Nag was honoured with the Dadasaheb Phalke Award (for 2024) on 22 September 2026 at the 72nd National Film Awards in Ekta Nagar. (दिग्गज कन्नड़ अभिनेता अनंत नाग को 22 सितंबर 2026 को दादासाहेब फाल्के पुरस्कार से सम्मानित किया गया।) Exam Boosters: (1) The Dadasaheb Phalke Award is India's highest cinema honour, instituted in 1969 (first recipient: Devika Rani). (2) Mithun Chakraborty received it for 2022, and Waheeda Rehman for 2021. (3) Ekta Nagar (Kevadia, Gujarat) is home to the Statue of Unity (182 m).
qe: Who was conferred the prestigious Dadasaheb Phalke Award (for 2024) on 22 September 2026 at the 72nd National Film Awards held at Ekta Nagar, Gujarat?

q: अपने चर्चित ऐतिहासिक उपन्यास "क्रिमसन स्प्रिंग" (Crimson Spring) के लिए अंग्रेजी भाषा श्रेणी में साहित्य अकादमी पुरस्कार 2025 किसने जीता?
e: Former Indian diplomat and author Navtej Sarna won the Sahitya Akademi Award 2025 in English for his novel "Crimson Spring", set around the Jallianwala Bagh massacre. (नवतेज सरना को उनके उपन्यास "क्रिमसन स्प्रिंग" के लिए अंग्रेजी का साहित्य अकादमी पुरस्कार 2025 मिला।) Exam Boosters: (1) Sahitya Akademi Awards are conferred annually in 24 languages (22 Eighth Schedule languages + English + Rajasthani). (2) The first Sahitya Akademi Award in English went to R. K. Narayan for "The Guide" (1960).
qe: Who won the Sahitya Akademi Award 2025 in the English language category for his acclaimed historical novel "Crimson Spring"?

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में मुंबई के निकट स्थित कौन-सा समुद्री तेल टर्मिनल भारत का पहला "प्लास्टिक-मुक्त तेल टर्मिनल" (Plastic-Free Oil Terminal) बना?
e: Jawahar Dweep (formerly Butcher Island), operated by the Mumbai Port Authority, became India's first Plastic-Free Oil Terminal in October 2026 under green port sustainability initiatives. (अक्टूबर 2026 में जवाहर द्वीप भारत का पहला प्लास्टिक-मुक्त तेल टर्मिनल बना।) Exam Boosters: (1) Jawahar Dweep handles crude oil imports for Mumbai's major refineries. (2) India banned identified single-use plastic items nationwide effective 1 July 2022.
qe: In October 2026, which marine oil terminal near Mumbai became India's first "Plastic-Free Oil Terminal"?

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में बाघों की आबादी पुनर्जीवित करने हेतु बक्सा टाइगर रिज़र्व (Buxa Tiger Reserve) में बाघ पुनर्वास कार्यक्रम प्रारंभ किया गया। बक्सा टाइगर रिज़र्व किस राज्य में स्थित है?
e: Buxa Tiger Reserve is situated in Alipurduar district of northern West Bengal near the Bhutan border; the October 2026 reintroduction program aims to restore a viable breeding tiger population there. (बक्सा टाइगर रिज़र्व पश्चिम बंगाल में स्थित है।) Exam Boosters: (1) Project Tiger was launched on 1 April 1973 from Jim Corbett National Park, Uttarakhand. (2) Sundarbans Tiger Reserve is the other tiger reserve in West Bengal. (3) Uttar Pradesh has 4 tiger reserves: Dudhwa, Pilibhit, Amangarh, and Ranipur (Chitrakoot).
qe: In October 2026, a major Tiger Reintroduction Program was launched in Buxa Tiger Reserve to revive its wild tiger population. In which Indian state is Buxa Tiger Reserve located?

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में भारत ने पांडुलिपि संरक्षण (Manuscript Conservation) और अभिलेखीय विरासत के संरक्षण हेतु किस यूरोपीय देश के साथ द्विपक्षीय समझौता ज्ञापन (MoU) पर हस्ताक्षर किए?
e: India and France signed an MoU in October 2026 for joint collaboration in manuscript conservation, digitization, and archival restoration. (अक्टूबर 2026 में भारत और फ्रांस ने पांडुलिपि संरक्षण हेतु समझौता ज्ञापन पर हस्ताक्षर किए।) Exam Boosters: (1) The National Mission for Manuscripts (NAMAMI) was launched by the Ministry of Culture in 2003. (2) The Gyan Bharatam Mission was announced in Union Budget 2025–26 to survey and conserve over 1 crore manuscripts across India.
qe: In October 2026, India signed a bilateral Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) for Manuscript Conservation and archival heritage preservation with which European nation?

q:
अक्टूबर 2026 में आयोजित "SAREX-2026" के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: SAREX-2026 का 12वाँ संस्करण भारतीय तटरक्षक बल (Indian Coast Guard) द्वारा आयोजित किया गया।
कथन II: SAREX मुख्य रूप से समुद्री खोज एवं बचाव (SAR) की तैयारी और सामूहिक बचाव समन्वय पर केंद्रित है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: न तो I और न ही II
e: Both statements are correct. The Indian Coast Guard conducted the 12th National Maritime Search and Rescue Exercise (SAREX-2026) in October 2026 to validate national and international maritime rescue response. Exam Boosters: (1) Indian Coast Guard Day is observed on 1 February (formally established under Coast Guard Act, 1978). (2) Its motto is "Vayam Rakshamah" (वयं रक्षामः — We Protect).
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding "SAREX-2026" conducted in October 2026:
Statement I: The 12th edition of SAREX-2026 was conducted by the Indian Coast Guard.
Statement II: SAREX focuses primarily on maritime Search and Rescue (SAR) preparedness and mass rescue coordination.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q: नेपाल सीमा पर बनबसा से निकलने वाली उत्तर प्रदेश की सबसे लंबी नहर प्रणाली कौन-सी है?
e: The Sharda Canal (built 1920–1928, originating at Banbasa on the Sharda/Mahakali river) is the longest canal network in Uttar Pradesh (~12,368 km including distributaries). Exam Boosters: (1) Eastern Yamuna Canal (1830) is the oldest canal in UP. (2) Upper Ganga Canal originates from Haridwar; Lower Ganga Canal originates from Narora (Bulandshahr).
qe: Which is the longest canal system in Uttar Pradesh, originating from Banbasa on the Nepal border?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश की कौन-सी अनुसूचित जनजाति मुख्यतः तराई क्षेत्र (लखीमपुर खीरी, बहराइच, श्रावस्ती, महाराजगंज) में निवास करती है और दीपावली को शोक पर्व के रूप में मनाती है?
e: The Tharu tribe resides along the Indo-Nepal Terai belt of Uttar Pradesh and traditionally observes Deepawali as a mourning festival (offering 'Roti' to ancestors); they follow a joint family system and celebrate the 'Bajhar' festival. Exam Boosters: (1) Gond is the largest tribal group in UP by population (concentrated in Sonbhadra, Mirzapur, Deoria). (2) Buksa (Bhoksa) tribe mainly inhabits Bijnor district; Sahariya tribe inhabits Lalitpur district.
qe: Which Scheduled Tribe of Uttar Pradesh predominantly inhabits the Terai region (Lakhimpur Kheri, Bahraich, Shravasti, Maharajganj) and observes Deepawali as a day of mourning (शोक पर्व)?

q:
सूची-I (उत्तर प्रदेश का शोध संस्थान) को सूची-II (शहर) से सुमेलित कीजिए:
1. भारतीय दलहन अनुसंधान संस्थान — (a) लखनऊ
2. केंद्रीय औषधि अनुसंधान संस्थान — (b) कानपुर
3. भारतीय पशु चिकित्सा अनुसंधान संस्थान — (c) वाराणसी
4. भारतीय सब्जी अनुसंधान संस्थान — (d) इज्जतनगर (बरेली)
e: IIPR is in Kanpur (1-b); CDRI is in Lucknow (2-a); IVRI is in Izatnagar, Bareilly (3-d); and IIVR is in Varanasi (4-c). Exam Boosters: (1) National Sugar Institute (NSI) is in Kanpur, while Indian Institute of Sugarcane Research (IISR) is in Lucknow. (2) Central Institute for Research on Goats (CIRG) is at Makhdoom (Mathura).
qe:
Match List-I (Research Institute in UP) with List-II (City):
1. Indian Institute of Pulses Research (भारतीय दलहन अनुसंधान संस्थान) — (a) Lucknow
2. Central Drug Research Institute (केंद्रीय औषधि अनुसंधान संस्थान) — (b) Kanpur
3. Indian Veterinary Research Institute (भारतीय पशु चिकित्सा अनुसंधान संस्थान) — (c) Varanasi
4. Indian Institute of Vegetable Research (भारतीय सब्जी अनुसंधान संस्थान) — (d) Izatnagar (Bareilly)

q: लखनऊ का प्रसिद्ध "बड़ा इमामबाड़ा" (भूलभुलैया के लिए विख्यात) 1784 में अवध के किस नवाब द्वारा बनवाया गया था?
e: Nawab Asaf-ud-Daula built the Bara Imambara (and Rumi Darwaza) in 1784 as a famine-relief project; its architect was Kifayatullah. Exam Boosters: (1) Asaf-ud-Daula shifted the capital of Awadh from Faizabad to Lucknow in 1775. (2) Chota Imambara was built by Muhammad Ali Shah in 1838. (3) Wajid Ali Shah was the last Nawab of Awadh (annexed by Lord Dalhousie in 1856 on grounds of misgovernance).
qe: The iconic "Bara Imambara" (बड़ा इमामबाड़ा) in Lucknow, famous for its Bhool Bhulaiyaa, was constructed in 1784 by which Nawab of Awadh?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का 594 किमी लंबा गंगा एक्सप्रेसवे अपने पश्चिमी और पूर्वी छोर पर क्रमशः किन दो जिलों को जोड़ता है?
e: The 594 km Ganga Expressway connects Meerut (Bijauli village) in western UP to Prayagraj (Judapur Dandu village) passing through 12 districts. Exam Boosters: (1) Purvanchal Expressway (341 km) connects Lucknow to Ghazipur. (2) Bundelkhand Expressway (296 km) connects Chitrakoot to Etawah. (3) Agra–Lucknow Expressway is 302 km long.
qe: The 594 km long Ganga Expressway in Uttar Pradesh connects which two districts at its western and eastern terminals respectively?

q: सम्राट अशोक का कौन-सा वृहत् शिलालेख कलिंग युद्ध (261 ई.पू.) की विभीषिका और उसके बाद "धम्म-विजय" की नीति का वर्णन करता है?
e: Major Rock Edict XIII is the longest of Ashoka's rock edicts and records the Kalinga War (fought in his 8th regnal year, 261 BCE) and his remorse leading to Dhamma-Vijaya. Exam Boosters: (1) James Prinsep first deciphered Ashoka's Brahmi inscriptions in 1837. (2) Maski, Gujarra, Nettur, and Udegolam minor rock edicts explicitly mention Ashoka's personal name "Ashoka".
qe: Which Major Rock Edict of Emperor Ashoka describes the horrors of the Kalinga War (261 BCE) and his subsequent shift to "Dhamma-Vijaya"?

q: सामाजिक समानता और स्त्री शिक्षा को बढ़ावा देने के लिए 1873 में पुणे में "सत्यशोधक समाज" की स्थापना किसने की थी?
e: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule founded Satyashodhak Samaj in 1873 and authored the famous book "Gulamgiri" (1873). Together with Savitribai Phule, he opened India's first girls' school in Pune in 1848. Exam Boosters: (1) Swami Vivekananda founded Ramakrishna Mission in 1897 (Belur Math). (2) Sri Narayana Guru led the Vaikom/SNDP movement in Kerala ("One Caste, One Religion, One God for Mankind").
qe: Who founded the "Satyashodhak Samaj" (सत्यशोधक समाज) in Pune in 1873 to champion social equality and women's education?

q: परांतक प्रथम के प्रसिद्ध "उत्तरमेरूर अभिलेख" किस दक्षिण भारतीय राजवंश के अंतर्गत स्थानीय ग्राम स्वशासन (सभा एवं उर) का विस्तृत प्रमाण देते हैं?
e: The Uttaramerur inscriptions (10th century CE, Tamil Nadu) of Chola king Parantaka I detail the Kudavolai (lottery) electoral system for village committees (Variyams) under the Chola Empire. Exam Boosters: (1) Vijayalaya founded the Imperial Chola dynasty (capital: Thanjavur). (2) Rajaraja I built the Brihadeeswarar Temple at Thanjavur; Rajendra I built Gangaikonda Cholapuram and led naval expeditions to Srivijaya.
qe: The famous "Uttaramerur Inscriptions" of Parantaka I provide detailed evidence of local village self-government (Sabha and Ur) under which South Indian dynasty?

q: भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन (अगस्त 1942) के दौरान निम्नलिखित में से किसने बंबई से भूमिगत "कांग्रेस रेडियो" का संचालन किया था?
e: Usha Mehta established and ran the secret Congress Radio in Bombay during the 1942 Quit India Movement to broadcast news and speeches of Ram Manohar Lohia and others. Exam Boosters: (1) Aruna Asaf Ali hoisted the tricolour at Gowalia Tank Maidan (August Kranti Maidan) on 9 August 1942. (2) Parallel governments (Prati Sarkar) during 1942 were formed at Ballia (Chittu Pandey), Tamluk (Jatiya Sarkar), and Satara (Nana Patil).
qe: During the Quit India Movement (August 1942), who among the following operated the underground "Congress Radio" from Bombay?

q: भारत में किस सूफी सिलसिले की स्थापना ख्वाजा मोइनुद्दीन चिश्ती ने अजमेर में की थी, जिसने 'समा' (भक्ति संगीत) तथा राजदरबार की राजनीति से दूरी पर बल दिया?
e: Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti ("Gharib Nawaz") established the Chishti order in India at Ajmer (late 12th century). Prominent Chishti saints include Qutbuddin Bakhtiyar Kaki, Baba Farid, Nizamuddin Auliya, and Nasiruddin Chirag-i-Delhi. Exam Boosters: (1) Suhrawardi saints (Bahauddin Zakariya) accepted royal grants and political posts. (2) Naqshbandi order (Shaikh Ahmad Sirhindi) opposed Akbar's syncretic policies and Sama.
qe: Which Sufi Silsilah (order) in India was founded by Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti at Ajmer and emphasized Sama (devotional music) and detachment from royal court politics?

q: स्वतंत्रता के तुरंत बाद 1948–49 में नियुक्त किस आयोग ने विश्वविद्यालय अनुदान आयोग (UGC) की स्थापना की सिफारिश की थी?
e: The University Education Commission (1948–49), chaired by Dr. S. Radhakrishnan, recommended setting up the UGC (inaugurated 1953; made a statutory body by UGC Act, 1956). Exam Boosters: (1) Mudaliar Commission (1952–53) was the Secondary Education Commission. (2) NCERT was established in 1961; NCTE became a statutory body under NCTE Act, 1993 (effective 1995).
qe: Which Commission, appointed in 1948–49 immediately after Independence, recommended the establishment of the University Grants Commission (UGC)?

q: भारतीय संविधान के किन अनुच्छेदों में "धार्मिक स्वतंत्रता का अधिकार" (Right to Freedom of Religion) की गारंटी दी गई है?
e: Articles 25 to 28 deal with Freedom of Religion: Art 25 (freedom of conscience and profession/practice/propagation), Art 26 (manage religious affairs), Art 27 (no tax for promoting any religion), Art 28 (religious instruction in educational institutions). Exam Boosters: (1) Under Art 28(1), NO religious instruction can be provided in any educational institution wholly maintained out of State funds. (2) Articles 23–24: Right against Exploitation; Articles 29–30: Cultural & Educational Rights.
qe: Which Articles of the Indian Constitution guarantee the "Right to Freedom of Religion" (धार्मिक स्वतंत्रता का अधिकार)?

q: सितंबर 2021 में किस राष्ट्रीय विद्यालयी पोषण योजना का नाम बदलकर "पीएम पोषण" (PM POSHAN) किया गया और इसमें बालवाटिका (प्री-प्राइमरी) के बच्चों को भी शामिल किया गया?
e: The Mid-Day Meal Scheme (originally launched nationwide on 15 August 1995) was revamped as PM POSHAN in 2021 for 2021–26, covering Classes 1–8 and Balvatika students in government and government-aided schools. Exam Boosters: (1) Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan (2018) integrated SSA, RMSA, and Teacher Education (TE). (2) Tamil Nadu was the first state in India to introduce a midday meal scheme in schools.
qe: Which national school nutrition scheme was renamed "PM POSHAN" (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman) in September 2021, extending hot cooked meals to Balvatika (pre-primary) children as well?

q: भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 110 के अंतर्गत लोकसभा में प्रस्तुत कोई विधेयक "धन विधेयक" है या नहीं, इसका अंतिम निर्णय कौन करता है?
e: Under Article 110(3), the Speaker of the Lok Sabha certifies whether a Bill is a Money Bill, and the Speaker's endorsement is final (though SC in Roger Mathew Case 2019 noted judicial review is possible on gross illegality). Exam Boosters: (1) A Money Bill can be introduced ONLY in the Lok Sabha with prior recommendation of the President. (2) Rajya Sabha can detain a Money Bill for at most 14 days.
qe: Who decides whether a Bill introduced in the Lok Sabha is a "Money Bill" under Article 110 of the Indian Constitution, and whose decision is final?

q: किस संविधान संशोधन के अंतर्गत "बोडो, डोगरी, मैथिली और संथाली" को भारतीय संविधान की आठवीं अनुसूची में जोड़ा गया, जिससे भाषाओं की संख्या 22 हो गई?
e: The 92nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 2003 (effective 2004) added Bodo, Dogri, Maithili, and Santhali ("BDMS") to the Eighth Schedule. Exam Boosters: (1) 21st Amendment (1967): Added Sindhi (15th). (2) 71st Amendment (1992): Added Konkani, Manipuri, Nepali ("KMN" → 18). (3) 96th Amendment (2011): Changed spelling of "Oriya" to "Odia".
qe: Under which Constitutional Amendment was "Bodo, Dogri, Maithili, and Santhali" added to the Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution, taking the total to 22 languages?

q: दक्षिण भारत में पूर्वी घाट और पश्चिमी घाट किस स्थान पर आपस में मिलते हैं?
e: The Western Ghats (Sahyadri) and Eastern Ghats converge at the Nilgiri Hills (Blue Mountains, tri-junction of Tamil Nadu, Kerala, and Karnataka). Exam Boosters: (1) Doddabetta (2,637 m) is the highest peak of the Nilgiris. (2) Anamudi (2,695 m, Anamalai Hills, Kerala) is the highest peak in Peninsular India. (3) Jindhagada / Mahendragiri are major peaks of the Eastern Ghats.
qe: Where do the Eastern Ghats and the Western Ghats meet in southern India?

q: कर्क रेखा (23°30' उत्तरी अक्षांश) भारत के 8 राज्यों से होकर गुजरती है। यह निम्नलिखित में से किस राज्य से होकर नहीं गुजरती?
e: The Tropic of Cancer passes through 8 states (West to East): Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, and Mizoram. It does NOT pass through Manipur. Exam Boosters: (1) The Mahi River in India crosses the Tropic of Cancer twice. (2) Indian Standard Time (82°30' E, passing near Mirzapur/Prayagraj, UP) passes through 5 states: UP, MP, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, and Andhra Pradesh.
qe: The Tropic of Cancer (23°30' N) passes through 8 Indian states. Through which of the following states does it NOT pass?

q: जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार भारत का समग्र लिंगानुपात (प्रति 1,000 पुरुषों पर महिलाएँ) तथा शिशु लिंगानुपात (0–6 वर्ष) क्रमशः कितना था?
e: As per final Census 2011 figures, India's overall Sex Ratio was 943 (up from 933 in 2001), while the Child Sex Ratio (0–6 years) declined to 919 (from 927 in 2001). Exam Boosters: (1) Highest state sex ratio: Kerala (1,084); lowest state sex ratio: Haryana (879). (2) Uttar Pradesh overall sex ratio (2011): 912; Child sex ratio: 902.
qe: According to Census 2011, what was the overall Sex Ratio (females per 1,000 males) and Child Sex Ratio (0–6 years) of India respectively?

q: भारत में प्रतिभूति एवं पूँजी बाजार का नियमन करने वाला कौन-सा वैधानिक निकाय है (जिसे 1992 के संसदीय अधिनियम द्वारा वैधानिक दर्जा मिला)?
e: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) was initially set up as a non-statutory body in April 1988 and granted statutory powers on 30 January 1992 via the SEBI Act, 1992 (headquartered in Mumbai). Exam Boosters: (1) IRDAI (Hyderabad) regulates insurance; PFRDA regulates pensions; SIDBI (headquartered in Lucknow, est. 1990) finances MSMEs.
qe: Which statutory body regulates the securities and capital markets in India (given statutory status by an Act of Parliament in 1992)?

q: भारत में प्रमुख कृषि फसलों के लिए न्यूनतम समर्थन मूल्य (MSP) की आधिकारिक सिफारिश आर्थिक मामलों की मंत्रिमंडलीय समिति (CCEA) को किस संस्था द्वारा की जाती है?
e: The Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP, est. 1965 as Agricultural Prices Commission) recommends MSP for 22 mandated crops (plus Fair and Remunerative Price / FRP for sugarcane), and the CCEA approves and announces them. Exam Boosters: (1) FCI (est. 1965) handles procurement, storage, and buffer stock distribution. (2) Swaminathan Commission recommended MSP at C2 + 50%.
qe: Minimum Support Prices (MSP) for major agricultural crops in India are officially recommended by which body to the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA)?
oe: Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices — CACP

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा भारत में एक अप्रत्यक्ष कर (Indirect Tax) का उदाहरण है?
e: GST is a comprehensive, multi-stage, destination-based Indirect Tax where the incidence (tax burden) is shifted to the final consumer. Income Tax, Corporate Tax, and STT are Direct Taxes. Exam Boosters: (1) GST was implemented from 1 July 2017 via the 101st Constitutional Amendment Act, 2016. (2) Direct taxes are generally progressive, while indirect taxes tend to be regressive.
qe: Which of the following is an example of an INDIRECT tax in India?

q: मनुष्यों में मलेरिया रोग "प्लाज्मोडियम" नामक प्रोटोजोआ परजीवी से होता है, जिसका संचरण किसके काटने से होता है?
e: Malaria is transmitted by the bite of an infected Female Anopheles mosquito (Plasmodium falciparum causes cerebral malaria). Exam Boosters: (1) Female Aedes aegypti transmits Dengue, Chikungunya, and Zika virus. (2) Sandfly (Phlebotomus) transmits Kala-Azar (Leishmania). (3) Sir Ronald Ross discovered malaria transmission by mosquitoes (Nobel Prize 1902).
qe: Malaria in humans is caused by a protozoan parasite of the genus "Plasmodium", which is transmitted by the bite of:

q: सामान्य मानव धमनी रक्त का सन्निकट pH मान कितना होता है?
e: Normal human blood is slightly alkaline with a tightly regulated pH range of 7.35 to 7.45 (average 7.4). Exam Boosters: (1) The pH scale (0–14) was introduced by Danish chemist S. P. L. Sørensen in 1909. (2) Pure water pH = 7.0; Gastric juice (HCl) pH ≈ 1.5–2.0; Milk pH ≈ 6.5–6.7.
qe: What is the approximate pH value of normal human arterial blood?

q: साइबर सुरक्षा एवं सूचना प्रौद्योगिकी (ICT) में "फिशिंग" (Phishing) क्या है?
o: तेज इंटरनेट स्थानांतरण हेतु बड़ी फाइलों को संपीड़ित करना
भ्रामक ईमेल/संदेशों द्वारा पासवर्ड या बैंक विवरण चुराने का कपटपूर्ण प्रयास
हार्डवेयर फ़ायरवॉल द्वारा हार्ड ड्राइव को एन्क्रिप्ट करना
क्लाउड नेटवर्क पर ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम ड्राइवर स्वतः अपडेट करना
e: Phishing is a social-engineering cyberattack in which attackers masquerade as trusted entities via fake emails, SMS (Smishing), or websites to trick victims into revealing passwords, OTPs, or financial data. Exam Boosters: (1) Ransomware encrypts victim data and demands ransom for decryption. (2) Firewall monitors and filters incoming/outgoing network traffic based on security rules. (3) CERT-In is India's national nodal agency for cybersecurity incident response.
qe: In cybersecurity and ICT, what is "Phishing" (फिशिंग)?
oe: Compressing large multimedia files for faster internet transfer
A fraudulent attempt via deceptive emails/messages to steal sensitive credentials like passwords or bank details
Encrypting a computer's hard drive using hardware firewalls
Updating operating system drivers automatically over cloud networks
